paper.title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality

result.summary: 本文提出结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过结构化矩阵（特别是半可分矩阵）建立状态空间模型（SSM）与注意力变体之间的理论联系 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS3.p3]。该框架将SSM的计算重新解释为半可分矩阵乘法，并据此设计出结合线性递归与二次注意力两种模式的分块算法 [S6.p2][S6.p4]。基于SSD，作者提出Mamba-2架构，其核心层是Mamba选择性SSM的改进，速度提升2-8倍，同时在语言建模上保持与Transformer的竞争力 [abstract]。实验表明Mamba-2在困惑度和实际运行时间上帕累托优于Mamba和Transformer++ [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3][S9.F9]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在建立结构化SSM与注意力变体之间的丰富理论联系，从而将原本为Transformer开发的算法与系统优化迁移到SSM上，以构建性能更好且随序列长度扩展更高效的基础模型 [S1.p2]。作者指出，SSM的发展与社区改进Transformer的努力显得脱节，导致SSM比Transformer更难理解和实验，且从算法和系统角度高效训练SSM仍具挑战 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our main goal is to develop a rich body of theoretical connections between structured SSMs and variants of attention.

This will allow us to transfer algorithmic and systems optimizations originally developed for Transformers to SSMs, towards the goal of building foundation models that perform better than Transformers while scaling more efficiently in sequence length.
the development of SSMs have appeared disjoint from the community’s collective effort to improve Transformers
it is more difficult to understand and experiment with SSMs compared to Transformers, and it remains challenging to train SSMs as efficiently as Transformers

method.text: 论文提出结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过结构化矩阵（具有次二次参数和乘法复杂度的矩阵）的抽象来连接结构化SSM与注意力变体 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。核心思想是证明状态空间模型等价于一类称为半可分矩阵的结构化矩阵，从而将SSM的高效计算问题归约为结构化矩阵乘法算法 [S3.SS3.p3][S3.SS4.p1]。基于此，作者提出一种分块分解算法：对角块用对偶注意力模式通过矩阵乘法计算，非对角块利用半可分矩阵的秩结构分解为更小的递归 [S6.p4]。

evidence.quote: Our framework connecting structured SSMs and variants of attention, which we call structured state space duality (SSD), is made through the abstractions of structured matrices
the sequence transformation operator $\mathsf{SSM}$ ( Definition 2.2) coincides with the matrix construction operator $\mathsf{SSS}$ ( Definition 3.2)
it will allow us to reduce the problem of efficient computation of SSMs (and other sequence models) into efficient algorithms for structured matrix multiplication

The diagonal blocks can be computed using the dual attention mode, which can be efficiently done with matrix multiplications, while the off-diagonal blocks can be factored by the rank-structure of semiseparable matrices and reduced to a smaller recurrence.

experiments.text: 作者在Pile数据集上进行语言建模实验，模型规模从125M到2.7B参数，遵循GPT3的深度和宽度规格，并与Mamba及Transformer++对比预训练困惑度和零样本评估 [S9.SS2.p1]。在2.7B规模（64层）、训练300B token的设置下，比较了Transformer++、纯Mamba-2、Mamba-2-MLP、Mamba-2-Attention和Mamba-2-MLP-Attention等不同层组合 [S9.SS2.SSS3.Px2.p1]。此外还进行了速度基准测试，并指出在短序列长度（如2K）下Mamba-2整体训练效率可能不如Transformer [S9.SS3.p2]。

evidence.quote: The model sizes (depth and width) follow GPT3 specifications, from 125m to 2.7B. We use the Pile dataset
we evaluate at the 2.7B scale (64 layers), trained to 300B tokens on the Pile
the Mamba-2 model as a whole might not be as efficient to train as Transformer at short sequence length (e.g. at $2K$)

findings.text: SSD算法比Mamba优化的选择性扫描实现快2-8倍，同时允许更大的递归状态尺寸（可达Mamba的8倍或更高，且减速极小） [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。SSD与优化softmax注意力实现（FlashAttention-2）相比具有高度竞争力，在序列长度2K处交叉，在16K处快6倍 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。Mamba-2在困惑度和实际运行时间上帕累托优于Mamba和Transformer++ [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3][S9.F9]。在2.7B规模、300B token训练下，Mamba-2优于Mamba-2.8B、Pythia-2.8B甚至Pythia-6.9B [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。SSD层与注意力层互补：纯SSD与Transformer++性能几乎相同，但混合少量注意力层可超越两者 [S9.SS2.SSS3.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: A dedicated implementation of SSD is $2-8\times$ faster than the optimized selective scan implementation of Mamba
while simultaneously allowing for much larger recurrent state sizes ( $8\times$ the size of Mamba or even higher, with minimal slowdown)
crossing over at sequence length 2K and 6 $\times$ faster at sequence length 16K
finding that it Pareto dominates Mamba and Transformer++ in both perplexity and wall-clock time
Mamba-2 with 2.7B parameters trained on 300B tokens on the Pile outperforms Mamba-2.8B, Pythia-2.8B and even Pythia-6.9B

by themselves (e.g. in the Mamba-2 architecture vs. Transformer++) their performance (measured by perplexity) is nearly the same, but a mixture of SSD and attention layers outperforms the pure Mamba-2 or Transformer++ architecture

limitations.text: 作者指出，Mamba-2模型整体在短序列长度（如2K）下训练效率可能不如Transformer，因为相同参数量下Transformer有L/2个MLP层和L/2个注意力层，而Mamba-2有L个SSD层，MLP层因简单矩阵乘法和逐点线性而非常硬件高效 [S9.SS3.p2]。此外，作者提到许多其他矩阵分解可能带来更适合其他专门设置的SSD算法，半可分矩阵有丰富的文献和更多表示形式，甚至更高效的算法可能存在 [S6.SS3.SSS0.Px6.p4]。

evidence.quote: the Mamba-2 model as a whole might not be as efficient to train as Transformer at short sequence length (e.g. at $2K$)
a Transformer with $L$ layers would have $\frac{L}{2}$ MLP layers and $\frac{L}{2}$ attention layers, while a Mamba-2 model would have $L$ SSD layers for the same number of parameters
many other matrix decompositions are possible ... which may lead to more algorithms for SSDs that could be better for other specialized settings
semiseparable matrices have a rich literature and many more representations besides the SSS form that we use ( Definition 3.2), and even more efficient algorithms may be possible
